مقدمة

This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, to be carried out every five years as indicated by Y5 in the titled block

The generator of the steam 
turbine as any generator is used for generating the electricity. The generator 
type is brushless (self induced).

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Esam Darwish, reviewed by eng. Ahmed 
Fathy, revised by inspection and quality control at EDEPC eng Abouda Elbanna, 
approved by general manager eng. Mohamed Anan and accepted by head sector 
president eng. Mohamed Elsarrag .

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Be sure that the turbine is 
 out of service and turning gear is off.

Be sure that the all 
 electrical & instrumentation cables are completely isolated.

Be sure that the fire fighting 
 system is isolated.

التفكيك

Uncouple the LP / GEN 
 coupling. Use a hydraulic pump to unbolt the coupling bolts.

Measure the length of the 
 coupling bolts.

Check the alignment between 
 the LP / GEN coupling and record them (loosen coupling).

Sling and lift the four 
 coolers to be cleaned.

Unbolt and raise the upper and 
 lower part of the bearings No, 5 & 6 cover.

Measure the clearances of the 
 BRGs No, 5 & 6 seals and record them.

Extract the exciter using 
 special fixture for that.

Remove the screws & bolts 
 fixing the bearings No, 5 & No, 6 bearing block caps on the lower bearing 
 block.
